# BaeMeds (baemeds.com)

> Durable Medical Equipment (DME), Healthcare Supplies, and Clinical Rental Services across the United States.

## About BaeMeds
BaeMeds (BaeMeds Healthcare LLC) is a nationwide supplier of hospital-grade Durable Medical Equipment (DME), respiratory therapy equipment, and home healthcare supplies. We provide certified sales, flexible monthly rental plans, fast nationwide shipping, and dedicated 24/7 patient technical support across all 50 US states.

## Core Medical Equipment Categories & Offerings
- [Oxygen Concentrator Sales & Rental](https://baemeds.com/guides/oxygen-concentrator-rental-guide): 5L and 10L medical oxygen concentrators (HCPCS E1390/E1392) from leading brands (CAIRE, Drive DeVilbiss, Inogen, Philips Respironics) with fast nationwide shipping.
- [BiPAP & CPAP Sleep Apnea Therapy](https://baemeds.com/guides/bipap-machine-rental-guide): Doctor-prescribed non-invasive ventilation systems (HCPCS E0470/E0471/E0601) including ResMed AirSense 10, ResMed Lumis 150 VPAP ST, and Philips DreamStation.
- [Multipara Patient Monitors](https://baemeds.com/guides/patient-monitor-guide): Bedside vital signs monitoring systems with continuous ECG, SpO2, NIBP, and temperature for home stepdown recovery and clinical care.
- [Hospital Furniture & Mobility](https://baemeds.com/products?category=Hospital%20Furniture): Adjustable hospital beds, alternating pressure mattresses, and manual/power wheelchairs.
- [Medical Masks & Tubing](https://baemeds.com/products?category=Masks%20%26%20Accessories): CPAP/BiPAP masks (nasal and full-face), heated humidification chambers, and replacement tubing.
- [All Products Catalog](https://baemeds.com/products): Full medical catalogue including suction machines, nebulizers, diagnostic instruments, and mobility aids.
- [Institutional Bulk Orders](https://baemeds.com/bulk-orders): Wholesale facility procurement, tax-exempt institutional orders, and commercial healthcare accounts.
